title: VTC Directory — Entries — List — payload
description: Browse, search and filter a community's member directory. Each entry is projected for the caller: only fields the member, the community's ceiling and its policy all allow. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

query.description: Search text. At least three characters, or a whole nickname for an exact-nickname search.

filters.description: Facet filters: an entry matches when, for every filter, its value of the field is one of `values`. Only facets visible to the caller.

group.description: Restrict to members of this community group, as far as the caller may see its members.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller and the question (query, filters and group); a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 100; the responder chooses a default (25) and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: VTC Directory — Entries — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/directory/entries/list/0.2 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/directory/entries/list/0.2#response.

count.description: Matching entries. Absent when below the community's threshold.

fewerThan.description: Present instead of `count` when the count is below the threshold *k*: there are fewer than this many.

facets.description: Counts for the facets visible to the caller, over the whole result. Absent when none is.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.
